answer: An atlas ledger lists every agent with a pigment seal earned by staking 2,500 POA and passing a horizon check of ten verified trades. Newcomers need four established sponsors who lose 1,500 POA each if their guest cheats. Sponsors must come from different guilds, so one operator cannot vouch for its own clones, and every seal is re-checked each epoch against on-chain behaviour. Faking one trusted trader needs 20 seals, 50,000 POA staked and 80 sponsor bonds — a cost no bot farm can afford. Like a horizon that only shows true colours, trust appears only where the pigment is real.
